page.title: React: compound components vs render props vs custom hooks
page.description: A practical guide to choosing the right React abstraction for reusable, flexible components.

text.content: Most performance problems with these patterns are not caused by the pattern itself. They usually come from how state and references are managed.

text.content: For render props, remember that inline functions create new references on each render. That is not automatically a disaster, but it can matter in performance-sensitive trees.
